name: The Cats are Eating my Crayons
source:
A visual novel set in a modern-day, where two best friends have emotional conversations and experience situations that change their relationship completely.

[edited from [url=https://c-h-a-b-b-y.itch.io/the-cats-are-eating-my-crayons]itch.io[/url]]
